experiment: end-to-end answers to the comparative benchmark questions: scoped vs decomposed retrieval

grading.method: Blind side-by-side grading: per question the three systems were shown as system_A/B/C in a seeded random order with the decomposition trace removed; one grader agent per 10 questions graded all three against the gold answer, gold answer points and gold evidence, and an independent skeptic agent re-checked every grade and could change it. Labels were mapped back afterwards (blind_labels). A second identical blind pass graded the three prompt-v2.2 systems (*_v22; labels in blind_labels_v22, verdicts in best_v22).
